name: Cobalt

fursona.description: Cobalt is an anthro blue jay with a distinctive presence. He coloring is tawny coat, charcoal muzzle; his eyes are dark brown. He lives in a small flat near the old tram line. Cobalt keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset, with a life beyond work.

summary: Cobalt (Adrian Mercer) is a man anthro blue jay, born 1960-07-03, with hotel concierge as his work situation. Soft-spoken and dependable, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Cobalt is soft-spoken and dependable. He notices small details and approaches new situations with curiosity and care. He appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and is willing to reconsider an opinion.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Keeps reminder notes in a pocket.
• Night routine: He plans errands and social visits around his late schedule.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience can help him notice details, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: He welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Cobalt enjoys chess and city history. He remains open to new experiences, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He appreciates low-key company, sharing food after a shift, or talking without filling every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Cobalt while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about chess becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An unusual small problem would be easier to solve with another perspective.
• A small favor: He could use a second opinion or a helping hand with an unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use he/him pronouns for Cobalt. His gender, appearance, and species are part of a complete character; he is an anthro blue jay. Do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Cobalt's name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The late schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable during daytime scenes. He can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop through roleplay.
